At this rate, what is the depth of the bore 20 hours after drilling began?
MATH_M1.check: Rate = 90/10 = 9 m per hour, so depth = 34 + 9(18) = 196.

MATH_M1.stem: A paintings conservator has 300 minutes of studio time left this week. Each canvas she cleans takes 26 minutes and each frame she repairs takes 14 minutes, and she must complete 8 frame repairs. What is the greatest number of canvases she can clean in the time that is left?

A postal van drives for 3 hours on country roads at a constant speed and then for 2 hours on a motorway at a constant speed 6 kilometres per hour greater. The van covers 152 kilometres in all. What was its speed, in kilometres per hour, on the country roads?

A mosaic workshop writes the number of tiles needed for a panel as \(\frac{6x^{2}+11x-35}{3x-5}\), where x is the number of rows in the panel and \(x>3\). Which expression is equivalent to that number of tiles?
MATH_M1.check: 6x^2+11x-35 factors as (3x-5)(2x+7), so the quotient is 2x+7.

MATH_M1.stem: A kelp farm models the yield of one raft, in kilograms, as \(Y(n)=-8n^{2}+448n-500\), where n is the number of seeded lines on the raft. How many seeded lines give the greatest yield under this model?

A hospital tracks a radioactive tracer so that the activity remaining after d days is \(A(d)=6{,}250\left(\frac{1}{5}\right)^{d}\) becquerels. After how many days does this model give an activity of 50 becquerels?

A cartographer draws a parabolic depth contour \(y=x^{2}+4x-12\) across a straight survey line \(y=3x+8\), where x and y are measured in kilometres. The contour meets the line at two points. What is the product of the x-coordinates of those two points?
MATH_M1.check: x^2+4x-12 = 3x+8 gives x^2+x-20 = 0, whose roots 4 and -5 have product -20.

MATH_M1.stem: A tannery converts the raw mass g of a hide into a finishing index w using \(w=\frac{5g-14}{3}\). Which expression gives g in terms of w?

The power a wind turbine generates is modelled by \(P(v)=cv^{3}\), where v is the wind speed in metres per second, c is a constant and P is the power in kilowatts. At a wind speed of 6 metres per second the turbine generates 108 kilowatts. How many kilowatts does it generate at a wind speed of 10 metres per second?

A mat of invasive water hyacinth covers 2,000 square metres of a lagoon, and the area it covers grows by 15% each week. To the nearest square metre, how many square metres does the mat cover after 5 weeks?
A dyer uses 7 grams of madder root for every 4 metres of cloth, and madder root costs $3 per gram. What is the cost of the madder root needed to dye 96 metres of cloth?

A ferry operator cut the fare on one crossing by 20% in the spring and then raised the reduced fare by 35% in the autumn. A passenger travelling after both changes paid $54. What was the fare, in dollars, before either change?

The 14 members of a rowing club have a mean mass of 78 kilograms. The 6 members of the lightweight squad within that club have a mean mass of 62 kilograms. What is the mean mass, in kilograms, of the other 8 members of the club?

In a triangular roof truss, the largest angle measures 3 times the smallest angle, and the remaining angle measures 20° more than the smallest angle. What is the measure, in degrees, of the largest angle?
MATH_M1.check: a + 3a + (a+20) = 180 gives a = 32, so the largest angle is 96.

MATH_M1.stem: A conveyor belt carries gravel in a straight line from ground level to the top of a silo 15 metres high, and the belt makes an angle of 30° with the horizontal. Gravel travels along the belt at 2 metres per second. How many seconds does a piece of gravel take to travel the whole length of the belt?
MATH_M1.check: The belt is 15/sin 30 = 30 m long, and 30/2 = 15 seconds.

MATH_M1.stem: A solid scale model of a granite monument is built at one-quarter of the monument's linear dimensions. The finished monument contains 448 cubic feet of granite. How many cubic feet of granite does the model contain?
A vertical pole 2.4 metres tall casts a shadow 1.8 metres long on level ground. At the same moment a nearby spire casts a shadow 31.5 metres long. How many metres tall is the spire?
MATH_M1.check: The triangles are similar, so the spire is (2.4/1.8)(31.5) = 42 m tall.

MATH_M2E.stem: A bindery sews 8 signatures into every book it makes and used 152 signatures altogether. How many books did the bindery make?
A hiker's pack weighs 23 kilograms. She leaves 5 kilograms of supplies at a mountain hut and divides the rest of the load equally among 3 dry bags. How many kilograms does each dry bag hold?
A kayak hire charges an $18 launch fee plus $13 for each hour on the water. What is the total charge, in dollars, for 5 hours on the water?

A community compost bin holds 240 kilograms of material at the start of the season and loses 15 kilograms of it each week. Which expression gives the mass of material, in kilograms, in the bin after w weeks?
MATH_M2E.check: Start at 240 and subtract 15 for each week.

MATH_M2E.stem: A service lift may carry no more than 8 passengers at a time. Which inequality gives all the possible numbers p of passengers the lift may carry at one time?
MATH_M2E.check: No more than 8 means 8 or fewer.

MATH_M2E.stem: A tram ticket costs $4. A traveller pays with a $50 note and receives $14 in change. How many tram tickets did the traveller buy?
On a long drive the function \(D(t)=560-70t\) gives the distance remaining, in kilometres, t hours after the drive begins. What is the meaning of 70 in this model?
MATH_M2E.check: 70 multiplies t, so it is the drop in the remaining distance per hour.

choices.label: A

MATH_M2E.stem: A signwriter uses \(5m-8\) grams of gold leaf on the letters of a sign and \(3m+14\) grams on the border, where m is the number of letters. Which expression gives the total mass of gold leaf, in grams, used on the sign?
A tiler lays \(3(2x+5)\) tiles along one wall of a bathroom. Which expression is equivalent to that number of tiles?
A tiling pattern grows so that the nth figure in the pattern uses \(3n^{2}\) tiles. How many tiles does the 4th figure use?

A caterer's rule says that a square baking pan whose sides are x centimetres long serves \(\frac{x^{2}}{50}\) people. One of the caterer's pans serves 8 people. How many centimetres long are the sides of that pan?
A photographer's exposure index is given by \(g(x)=\frac{x+9}{x-1}\), where x is the meter reading and \(x>1\). What is the exposure index when the meter reading is 5?
A lens grinder enlarges every measurement on a drawing by the scale factor \(16^{\frac{3}{4}}\). What is the value of that scale factor?
MATH_M2E.check: 16^(3/4) is the cube of the fourth root of 16, which is 2^3 = 8.

MATH_M2E.stem: A lily pond is stocked so that the number of lily pads h hours after stocking is \(P(h)=3\cdot 4^{h}\). How many lily pads are there 3 hours after stocking?
A decorator mixes paint using 3 parts white to 5 parts blue by volume. One batch uses 45 litres of white paint. How many litres of blue paint does that batch use?
The number of passengers using a rural bus route fell from 250 a day to 200 a day. By what percent did the number of passengers fall?

MATH_M2E.check: In order the counts are 2, 4, 6, 7, 9, so the median is 6.

MATH_M2E.stem: A carpenter cuts an isosceles bracket in the shape of a triangle in which two of the angles each measure 35°. What is the measure, in degrees, of the third angle?
A packing crate is a rectangular box measuring 6 feet by 4 feet by 3 feet. What is the volume of the crate, in cubic feet?
A square ceramic tile has an area of 169 square centimetres. What is the perimeter, in centimetres, of the tile?
MATH_M2E.check: The side is sqrt(169) = 13, so the perimeter is 4(13) = 52.

MATH_M2E.stem: A wheelchair ramp rises 5 metres while covering a horizontal distance of 12 metres. How many metres long is the sloping surface of the ramp?

MATH_M2H.stem: A metallurgist writes two blending constraints as \(6x-4y=10\) and \(9x+cy=15\), where x and y are the masses of two alloys in kilograms and c is a constant. Every pair \((x,y)\) that satisfies the first constraint also satisfies the second. What is the value of c?
MATH_M2H.check: Multiplying the first equation by 3/2 gives 9x - 6y = 15, so c = -6.

MATH_M2H.stem: A barometric altimeter reports an offset \(f(x)\) for a raw pressure reading x, and f is a linear function. The instrument's log records \(f(-4)=17\) and \(f(6)=-3\). For what value of x does \(f(x)=5\)?
MATH_M2H.check: Slope -20/10 = -2 and f(x) = -2x + 9, so f(x) = 5 at x = 2.

MATH_M2H.stem: A delivery van carries parcels of two kinds. Each parcel of the first kind has a mass of 12 kilograms and each parcel of the second kind has a mass of 18 kilograms, and the van may carry a total parcel mass of at most 960 kilograms. The van must carry at least 30 parcels of the first kind. What is the greatest number of parcels of the second kind the van can carry?
MATH_M2H.check: 12(30) + 18b <= 960 gives b <= 33.3, so 33 parcels.

MATH_M2H.stem: A framer cuts a rectangular mounting card whose length is 3 centimetres greater than its width, and the card has an area of 154 square centimetres. What is the perimeter, in centimetres, of the card?
MATH_M2H.check: w(w+3) = 154 gives w = 11 and length 14, so the perimeter is 2(25) = 50.

MATH_M2H.stem: A kiln controller turns a dial setting x into a firing temperature with \(h(x)=5x-1\), and the energy the kiln then draws at a firing temperature T is \(f(T)=T^{2}+3\). Which expression gives the energy the kiln draws in terms of the dial setting x?

The clearance between a parabolic arch and the roadway beneath it, in feet, is given by \(c(x)=3x^{2}+24x+50\), where x is the horizontal distance in feet from a fixed marker. Which equivalent form of the expression displays the minimum clearance as a constant or coefficient?
MATH_M2H.check: 3(x+4)^2 + 2 expands to 3x^2 + 24x + 50, and the minimum clearance is 2.

MATH_M2H.stem: A sheet of tinplate measuring 20 centimetres by 16 centimetres is made into an open tray by cutting a square of side x centimetres from each corner and folding the four flaps upward. The base of the finished tray has an area of 192 square centimetres. What is the value of x?
MATH_M2H.check: (20-2x)(16-2x) = 192 gives x^2 - 18x + 32 = 0, whose roots are 2 and 16; only 2 fits.

MATH_M2H.stem: The ratio of two cross-sectional areas in a ventilation duct is written as \(\frac{x^{2}-9}{x^{2}+7x+12}\), where \(x>3\). Which expression is equivalent to that ratio?
MATH_M2H.check: The numerator is (x-3)(x+3) and the denominator is (x+3)(x+4), so (x+3) cancels.

MATH_M2H.stem: The floor of a dry valley is modelled by \(y=k(x+2)(x-6)\), where k is a constant and x and y are measured in hundreds of metres. The model passes through the point \((0,-36)\). What is the least value of y the model takes?
MATH_M2H.check: k(2)(-6) = -36 gives k = 3; the vertex is at x = 2, where y = 3(4)(-4) = -48.

MATH_M2H.stem: While calibrating a pressure gauge a technician has to solve the equation \(\sqrt{2x+11}=x+4\). What is the only value of x that satisfies this equation?
MATH_M2H.check: Squaring gives x^2+6x+5 = 0 with roots -1 and -5; x = -5 makes the right side negative, so only x = -1 works.

MATH_M2H.stem: A foundry melts an alloy that is 40% copper together with an alloy that is 70% copper to obtain 90 kilograms of an alloy that is 60% copper. How many kilograms of the 70% alloy does the foundry use?

Students who followed programme X went on to score significantly higher on a common end-of-term assessment than students who followed programme Y. MATH_M2H.check: Legs 3 and 4 give a hypotenuse of 5, so sin J = 3/5, and cos K equals sin J.

MATH_M2H.stem: A caterer packs portions into trays that hold 8 portions each and boxes that hold 5 portions each. She must pack at least 60 portions and may use at most 9 containers in all. If she uses exactly 4 boxes, how many trays must she use?

MATH_M2H.stem: The mass of a spool of cable is a linear function of the length of cable wound on it. A spool holding 40 metres of cable has a mass of 27 kilograms, and a spool holding 100 metres of cable has a mass of 51 kilograms. What is the mass, in kilograms, of the empty spool?
